title: Umutima uri inyuma y'ikigirwamana
intro: Mu gitutu c’uguhunga gukomeye kuva ku bubisha, uwo muntu w’akabanga yarindiriye mu bugaragwa. Mu gihe umurongozi w’abantu batoranijwe yaduga umusozi mweranda kugira ngo basangire n’Imana, ikigeragezo gikomeye caramanukiye abasigaye inyuma. Uwo muntu yarafashe ako kanya kugira ngo asubire guhingura ivyo umuryango wose wemera. Igihe uwo murongozi yagarutse afise ukuri, haciye hategekwa igihano kidasanzwe kandi c’ibihe bidahera. Woba ushobora gusobanura uwo mutima w’impaka kandi w’ubuhendanyi wari nde?
clues: Nagiye n’abantu bari barabohowe mu minwe y’umunyarugomo akomeye biciye ku bimenyetso vy’igitangaza.
Igihe umurongozi wabo yaduga ku musozi kugira ngo aronke ubuyobozi, nararindira mu basigaye inyuma.
Narakorakoranya ivyuma vy’agaciro mu bisharizo vyabo maze nkabihinguramwo ikintu gitera ijwi.
Biciye muri ico kiremwa, naravyemeje uruvyaro rwose ko babonye imana yabo mu bugaragwa.
Uwo murongozi agarutse, barantoye, barambaza icatumye ngira mwene ukwo guhenda.
Igihano canje muri iyi si cari uko ata n’umwe yonkorako canke ngo anyegere, ikimenyetso c’isoni ngira ibihe vyose.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
